| Risk Factor | Current | Trend | Threshold |

| Interest Coverage (implied) | ~2.7x | ↓ deteriorating | <2.0x = covenant risk |

**The math**: Equity grew only 10% while liabilities grew 36%. This means **debt is funding growth, not operations**. If interest rates remain high (CBE at 27.25%), the 238% interest expense growth will continue to compress margins.

The bull claims the negative EY spread is "regime-level compression." This is **partially true but misleading**:

- Revenue is EGP-denominated but **debt may have foreign currency components**
- The bull claims "pricing power" — but telecom tariffs are **regulated** by the government
- EGP has lost ~60% of its value since 2022 — further devaluation would **destroy real returns**

- Telecom Egypt is **majority state-owned** — minority shareholders have limited influence
